title: Why doesn't intercompany balance?
learnerBrief: Intercompany doesn't balance at March close: the US↔CA receivable and payable don't match by $4,182. Find out why. The answer needs to name the root cause, not just the amount.

groundTruth.explanation: Both sides booked defensibly: CA at the 3/15 transaction-date rate, US at the 3/31 month-end rate. The variance is pure FX timing on a CAD-denominated parent charge.
